name: stasis_snare_gone_before_trigger_resolves
notes: P50a878933a G4. Printed: '... exile target creature an opponent controls until this enchantment leaves the battlefield.' CR 610.3c: if the Snare has already left the battlefield when its enters trigger resolves, the creature is not exiled at all. The Snare enters with its trigger held (targeting seat 1's Wolf); in response another effect destroys the Snare; the trigger then resolves and the Wolf stays on the battlefield.
